get.description:
This is the FHIR v4.0.1 based Service Based Url for the facility.

This is the modern FHIR v4.0.1 api with dynamic user registration and bulk exporting.  All the previous swagger documentation is for the legacy oData and filesystem api.

Multiple failed login attempts, or more than 60 requests per minute will lock a user out.  YOU ARE NOT ALLOWED TO THROTTLE THIS API.  It is provided as a courtesy.

We recommend the open-source free firely client for api client/consumption:
https://github.com/FirelyTeam/firely-net-sdk

The nuget command is:
Install-Package Hl7.Fhir.R4 -Version 5.10.0

For examples on how to consume the api, please visit the documentation at this url:https://docs.fire.ly/projects/Firely-NET-SDK/en/latest/

Getting Started with Firely can be reached at this url:https://docs.fire.ly/projects/Firely-NET-SDK/en/latest/start.html

All of cyfluent EHR facilities will use their facilityCode in the URL below (AKMD, HBSH, HUMFA, PGP, PPEET, RCLAYTON, STEIN)

  https://www.cyfluentphr.com/fhirapi/{facilityCode}/service-base-url

The above url is an inferno compliant fhir api url for cyfluent ehr data. If you need access to cyfluent fhir api, need to request through email to support@cyfluent.com, You will get response within 24 hours.

Once the request is approved will provide you with clientid and clientsecret, you can use them to access the fhir compliant data.

If you are unable to consume the open-source libraries above, the following link with unit test samples should get you started. 
You need to replace the facilityCode in above fhir url to your matching facilityCode, clientid and clientsecret in the unit test samples. 

www.cyfluentphr.com/_files/CURES/FhirUnitTests.txt

This is for non-FHIR oData/REST. Please use base/YourPathWithoutLoginPageName/Secure/ Multiple failed login attempts, or more than 30 requests per minute will lock a user out. YOU ARE NOT ALLOWED TO THROTTLE THIS API. It is provided as a courtesy. Accounts that are inactive for 30 minutes lose their api session and will need to log back in. Please download the sample api client at https://www.cyfluentchart.com/_Files/API.zip The credentials need to be modified in the "Main" method. Please reference the following code in the provided zip to get started...
var c = new Provider { HumanResourceID = "GetThisGuidFromCyfluentSupport", FirstName = "YourFirstName", LastName = "YourLastName", Title = "Your Professional Titles", Username = "TheUsernameYouUseToLogin", Password = "YourCleartextPassword", FacilityID = "GetThisGuidFromCyfluentSupport", FacilityCode = "GetThisStringFromCyfluentSupport", LoginUrl = "The url of the Default.aspx page you log into" }; c.LogIn(); ... c.LogOut();

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: payload = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new JObject { new JProperty("userName", Username), new JProperty("password", Password), new JProperty("facilityCode", FacilityCode), new JProperty("facilityID", FacilityID), new JProperty("hrId", HumanResourceID) });

200.description: userkey and cookie string are returned

get.summary: CRUD database operations (restricted to your facility)
get.description:
For more details on how the secure open data protocol works, please visit https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/framework/data/wcf/wcf-data-services-client-library
Please feel free to reference the following xml files that detail the service reference and also the metadata https://www.cyfluentchart.com/_Files/Desktop.zip
For billing clients: to pull newly signed encounters with billable codes, use oData to query the ApplicationInterfaceDataQueue for a status of 'Ready' and an InterfaceType of 1, and use the resulting encounterIDs to pull the relevant encounter and actionitem table records. Or, you may optionally call our Guarded Service. For more details please contact support.

Lets discuss this sample oData request (there are other samples in the solution provided).
"Provider.ctx.CodeDiets.Expand(\"CodeSetDiet\").Take(50).Select(d => new { d.Code, d.CodeDescription, d.CodeDietID, d.CodeSetDietID, d.LogicalOrder, d.ObjectVersionDate }).ToList();"

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: select a custom object with only specific fields returning

get.description: Using the ApplicationFileID from the ApplicationFile table, you can pull a file from the file system.  These files are often listed on a patient's chart on the documents tab, and include things like encounter pdfs and lab results.
produces: the mimetype in the applicationfile table record

parameters.name: fileID
parameters.description: the ApplicationFileID from the ApplicationFile table

get.description: Using the patientID from the Patient table, you can pull the patient's MU3 compliant CCDA

parameters.name: FacilityID
parameters.description: the facilityid you are logged in under

post.description:
Prescription saves will update external systems automatically via FHIR (if connected and the prescription is administered or filled in-house. Otherwise it may just go to the external pharmacy).
An array of type PatientPrescriptionDto must be in the request body.

parameters.name: FacilityID
parameters.description: the facilityid you are logged in under

parameters.name: hold
parameters.description: whether to put the prescription on hold for authorization (users who do not have credentials have to do this)

parameters.name: PatientPrescriptionDto
parameters.description: the array of patientprescription data (can perform more than one action at once asynchronously)

200.description: the prescription status array (sometimes a pharmacy will not be able to receive and you will need to print, or an npi number will have been revoked)

post.description: Order saves will update external systems automatically via FHIR (if connected)

parameters.name: Dto
parameters.description:
The order(s) information.  In the example below an Albumin lab is ordered and completed with results, and two cpt modifiers are used.  The order is not tied to a specific encounter in this example, but it may still show on the encounter pdf if the performed/ordered datetime is around the time of an encounter.  You may submit more than one order (actionitem) at once.
You may use oData to review all the ActionItemTypes and status options.  Please feel free to contact support for more examples.

DrugIdentifier.description: the First Databank drug identifier (can be found by performing a drug search)

PharmacyCode.description: Code is taken from the ChangeHealthcare/Surescripts master pharmacy list
